name: Jinhai Medical Technology Limited
summary: Jinhai Medical Technology Limited, an investment holding company, provides minimally invasive surgery solutions, medical products, and related services in the People's Republic of China and Singapore. It also offers manpower outsourcing and ancillary services to building and construction contractors. In addition, the company provides IT services; construction ancillary services, such as warehousing, cleaning, and building maintenance services; and dormitory services. Further, it offers engineering design and consultancy services; sells graphene material products; and accommodation for foreign worker's dormitory service.
